company: 深圳市飞荣达科技股份有限公司
core_question: Can Feirongda convert rising AI-server and data-center liquid-cooling demand into sustained revenue growth, higher-value system content, improving thermal-management margins and normalized cash conversion fast enough to justify a high earnings multiple, while humanoid-robot liquid cooling remains upside rather than a valuation dependency?
dominant_variable: AI liquid-cooling revenue conversion, margin progression and cash conversion relative to already-elevated valuation expectations.

technology_stack.suspended_pump_integration: technical integration with Huake Cooling Core

strategic_investment.company: 华科冷芯（上海）动力科技有限公司

start_small_conditions: Price resets to approximately CNY 35 or lower while AI-liquid-cooling demand, batch-delivery evidence and earnings thesis remain intact.

OR new evidence at a higher price establishes materially stronger AI-liquid-cooling revenue, margin and cash conversion such that 2028 base-case attributable net profit credibly exceeds roughly CNY 1.0-1.1bn.
Portfolio exposure to correlated AI/liquid-cooling themes remains acceptable.
Starter remains experimental/high-conviction and within the existing TRQuant starter-risk limit rather than a full target risk unit.
add_conditions: AI liquid-cooling revenue or a defensible proxy grows materially faster than group revenue.
Thermal-management gross margin improves while liquid-cooling mix rises.
Rolling CFO/net-profit conversion normalizes above roughly 1x or working-capital build is visibly converted into revenue and cash.
Higher-content CDU, flow-control, quick-connect, pump-integrated or rack-level products become repeat batch revenue.
Major AI infrastructure customers maintain or raise real compute deployment plans.
trim_conditions: Price/multiple expands materially faster than earnings evidence.
Robot-liquid-cooling narrative becomes a major valuation driver before robot revenue/order evidence is material.
AI/liquid-cooling factor concentration in the portfolio becomes excessive.
kill_criteria: Two or more quarters of material AI-server/liquid-cooling order deterioration without a credible cyclical explanation.
Thermal-management revenue grows while gross margin continues structurally downward, indicating weak value capture or commodity competition.
Persistent CFO weakness, rising receivables/inventory and debt despite reported profit growth.
Material loss of key server/telecom customers or repeated failure to convert sample/pilot programs to batch orders.
Broad hyperscaler real-compute capex cuts coincide with weakening GPU/rack deployment evidence.
Robot revenue remains immaterial while the stock valuation becomes primarily dependent on robot-liquid-cooling expectations.

valuation.interpretation: Current valuation already requires rapid earnings compounding; robot option value should not be used to bridge missing AI-liquid-cooling cash conversion.

conditions: robot remains small but begins repeat-order validation
robot cooling becomes a real second curve

global_benchmark.benchmark_principle: Cross-market benchmarks define quality of revenue-to-margin-to-cash conversion; they are not mechanical fair-value comparables.

macro_overlay.interpretation: AI infrastructure demand remains structurally supportive, but sticky inflation/high rates increase discount-rate and valuation-compression risk.

unknowns: Standalone AI-liquid-cooling revenue is not disclosed.
Standalone AI-liquid-cooling gross margin is not disclosed.
Auditable AI-liquid-cooling backlog/order value and customer concentration are not disclosed.
Robot-liquid-cooling revenue and repeat production order value are not disclosed and are currently immaterial at group level.
Current FY2026-FY2028 sell-side consensus snapshot has not yet been added to the case.
Canonical CNINFO direct PDF URLs should be reconciled before decision-grade promotion.
A-share market-data permission was unavailable through IBKR; current price uses a completed-session public market-data source.

lessons.principle: For emerging thermal-management themes, separate the current cash-flow engine from future-option markets; do not use robot optionality to justify an AI-infrastructure valuation gap.
Rising liquid-cooling penetration does not guarantee supplier margin expansion; track content value, gross margin and cash conversion together.
Global leaders can be used to benchmark operating leverage and FCF quality without mechanically importing their valuation multiples into A-shares.

promotion_requirements: Reconcile load-bearing financial facts to canonical CNINFO direct filing URLs.
Obtain or explicitly close the gap on AI-liquid-cooling revenue/order/margin disclosure after targeted IR review.
Add current sell-side expectation history for FY2026-FY2028, classified as forecast evidence.
Complete the 2026-08-26 NVIDIA/U.S. macro evidence node and 2026-08-28 liquid-cooling re-underwrite.
Founder/reviewer explicitly approves action zones, sizing and kill criteria before decision_grade promotion.
